name: The Dawnmarket
description: A frantic, silent bazaar that operates only in the volatile hour following the dawn fracture.
full_description: Held in the fortified courtyard of Aethelgard's lower tier, this market springs to life the moment the Binding bells fall silent. Traders deal exclusively in ephemera that has 'bled through' from the Dreaming: bottles of condensed starlight, seeds of impossible plants, shifting silks, and fragments of alien music captured in glass orbs. All commerce is conducted through hushed whispers and intricate hand-signs, as loud emotions could attract lingering anomalies. Vigilants patrol the edges, their eyes scanning not for thieves, but for any trader or item beginning to destabilize. It is the primary source of rare components for Oniromancers and a barometer for the Veil's stability.
